uppartners-hermeus:lever:638f3ee1-3faf-4.title: Teamcenter Systems Administrator
uppartners-hermeus:lever:638f3ee1-3faf-4.description:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.


About The Role:
As a Teamcenter Systems Administrator, you will support and scale our Siemens Teamcenter environment across Engineering and Manufacturing operations. This is a highly operational, user-facing role focused on Teamcenter administration, engineering workflow support, release management, troubleshooting, engineering data integrity, and continuous process improvement. While the role will support Siemens NX users and CAD-related workflows, the primary focus is Teamcenter operations and enabling efficient engineering data management across the organization. 
  
You will work directly with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Digital Operations teams to ensure Teamcenter remains reliable, scalable, and operationally effective as the company continues to grow. This is not a passive ticket-based support role. The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting complex operational issues, observing real user behavior, improving workflows, supporting releases, administering system configurations, and proactively identifying opportunities to reduce engineering friction and improving processes.
uppartners-hermeus:lever:638f3ee1-3faf-4.descriptionHtml:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

About The Role:

As a Teamcenter Systems Administrator, you will support and scale our Siemens Teamcenter environment across Engineering and Manufacturing operations. This is a highly operational, user-facing role focused on Teamcenter administration, engineering workflow support, release management, troubleshooting, engineering data integrity, and continuous process improvement. While the role will support Siemens NX users and CAD-related workflows, the primary focus is Teamcenter operations and enabling efficient engineering data management across the organization. 
  

You will work directly with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Digital Operations teams to ensure Teamcenter remains reliable, scalable, and operationally effective as the company continues to grow. This is not a passive ticket-based support role. The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting complex operational issues, observing real user behavior, improving workflows, supporting releases, administering system configurations, and proactively identifying opportunities to reduce engineering friction and improving processes. 

Teamcenter Administration & Operational Support 

  • Configure, maintain, and scale Siemens Teamcenter environments to support a rapidly growing engineering organization 

  • Manage users, groups, roles, permissions, access controls, and environment configuration across evolving business needs 

  • Support and continuously improve Item, Item Revision, Dataset, BOM, and workflow management processes 

  • Troubleshoot Teamcenter issues impacting engineering workflows, releases, ownership, access, integrations, and data integrity 

  • Support engineering release workflows, approvals, status management, and change management processes while helping mature future-state release strategies 

  • Analyze system logs, workflow failures, and operational issues to identify root causes and implement scalable corrective actions 

  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to resolve technical and operational challenges 

  • Support Teamcenter upgrades, deployments, environment validation, and long-term platform roadmap initiatives 

  • Assist with Dispatcher-related troubleshooting and automated file generation processes (PDF, DXF, STEP, JT) 

  • Participate in evaluating and implementing new Teamcenter capabilities, modules, and operational improvements as the organization scales 

  • Help define scalable Teamcenter operational standards, governance models, and engineering data management practices 

Engineering Workflow & Data Management 

  • Support engineering teams in the creation, management, release, and maintenance of product data throughout the product lifecycle 

  • Standardize workflows, release processes, metadata usage, and engineering data governance practices 

  • Identify workflow bottlenecks, process gaps, recurring operational pain points, and opportunities for automation 

  • Improve usability and reduce engineering friction through process optimization, workflow redesign, and system enhancements 

  • Support BOM structure management, revision control, and configuration management processes 

  • Validate engineering data quality, traceability, and configuration consistency across systems 

  • Partner with Engineering and Digital Operations teams to improve scalability of engineering processes as product complexity and organizational size increase 

  • Contribute to future-state initiatives involving model-based engineering, digital thread visibility, workflow automation, and engineering process modernization 

NX & CAD User Support 

  • Support Siemens NX managed-mode environments, integrations, templates, configurations, and engineering workflows 

  • Troubleshoot NX-related operational issues involving Teamcenter integration, datasets, assemblies, drawings, and environment behavior 

  • Support rollout, adoption, and operationalization of new engineering tools, workflows, templates, and capabilities 

  • Assist engineering users with day-to-day CAD/PLM operational support needs 

  • Help improve engineering productivity by reducing workflow friction and improving system usability 

  • Support evolving engineering initiatives involving PMI, MBD, CAD automation, and digital engineering workflows 

  • Training, Documentation & User Enablement 

  • Create and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, support guides, release documentation, and workflow standards 

  • Conduct focused training sessions for engineering and operational teams 

  • Support onboarding activities for new Teamcenter and NX users 

  • Help users adopt standardized engineering workflows, release processes, and data management practices 

  • Communicate operational changes and system updates clearly to impacted teams 

  • Identify recurring training gaps and proactively improve user enablement strategies 

  • Build and maintain a scalable internal knowledge base supporting long term operational growth 

Cross-System Awareness & Digital Thread support 

  • Develop understanding of how Teamcenter interacts with ERP, MES, manufacturing, and enterprise reporting systems 

  • Support integration testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities involving Teamcenter and downstream systems 

  • Identify cross-system mismatches and escalate issues with clear operational and technical context 

  • Support digital thread initiatives connecting Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations 

  • Participate in future integration and process improvement initiatives involving Teamcenter, NetSuite, Manufacturo, and enterprise reporting platforms 

  • Help improve end-to-end engineering and manufacturing data consistency across enterprise systems 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered 
  • 5+ years of experience supporting Siemens Teamcenter in an engineering or manufacturing environment 
  • Strong understanding of Teamcenter administration, workflows, engineering data structures, release processes, and configuration management concepts 
  • Experience troubleshooting operational Teamcenter issues involving workflows, datasets, BOMs, ownership, access, integrations, and engineering data management 
  • Familiarity with Siemens NX managed-mode environments and CAD/PLM integrations 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills 
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams 
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, rapidly evolving engineering environments 
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to engineering data integrity and process consistency 
  • Interest in continuously improving engineering systems, workflows, and operational scalability  
  • Experience supporting Teamcenter integrations with ERP, MES, or enterprise reporting platforms 
  • Familiarity with Teamcenter Dispatcher, workflows, engineering release automation, and engineering change processes 
  • Exposure to Teamcenter ITK, APIs, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or customization frameworks 
  • Aerospace, defense, or complex hardware manufacturing experience 
  • Familiarity with SQL, reporting tools, enterprise data environments, or digital thread initiatives 
  • Experience supporting enterprise digital transformation or engineering systems modernization initiatives 
  • Exposure to PMI, MBD, CAD automation, or model-based engineering initiatives
  • Motivated by solving operational challenges with scalable technology solutions

    The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. US persons include U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending. 
     
    EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
    Hermeus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions at Hermeus are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobDescription.title: Teamcenter Systems Administrator
jobDescription.description:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.


About The Role:
As a Teamcenter Systems Administrator, you will support and scale our Siemens Teamcenter environment across Engineering and Manufacturing operations. This is a highly operational, user-facing role focused on Teamcenter administration, engineering workflow support, release management, troubleshooting, engineering data integrity, and continuous process improvement. While the role will support Siemens NX users and CAD-related workflows, the primary focus is Teamcenter operations and enabling efficient engineering data management across the organization. 
  
You will work directly with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Digital Operations teams to ensure Teamcenter remains reliable, scalable, and operationally effective as the company continues to grow. This is not a passive ticket-based support role. The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting complex operational issues, observing real user behavior, improving workflows, supporting releases, administering system configurations, and proactively identifying opportunities to reduce engineering friction and improving processes.
responsibilities: Teamcenter Administration & Operational Support
Configure, maintain, and scale Siemens Teamcenter environments to support a rapidly growing engineering organization
Manage users, groups, roles, permissions, access controls, and environment configuration across evolving business needs
Support and continuously improve Item, Item Revision, Dataset, BOM, and workflow management processes
Troubleshoot Teamcenter issues impacting engineering workflows, releases, ownership, access, integrations, and data integrity
Support engineering release workflows, approvals, status management, and change management processes while helping mature future-state release strategies
Analyze system logs, workflow failures, and operational issues to identify root causes and implement scalable corrective actions
Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to resolve technical and operational challenges
Support Teamcenter upgrades, deployments, environment validation, and long-term platform roadmap initiatives
Assist with Dispatcher-related troubleshooting and automated file generation processes (PDF, DXF, STEP, JT)
Participate in evaluating and implementing new Teamcenter capabilities, modules, and operational improvements as the organization scales
Help define scalable Teamcenter operational standards, governance models, and engineering data management practices
Engineering Workflow & Data Management
Support engineering teams in the creation, management, release, and maintenance of product data throughout the product lifecycle
Standardize workflows, release processes, metadata usage, and engineering data governance practices
Identify workflow bottlenecks, process gaps, recurring operational pain points, and opportunities for automation
Improve usability and reduce engineering friction through process optimization, workflow redesign, and system enhancements
Support BOM structure management, revision control, and configuration management processes
Validate engineering data quality, traceability, and configuration consistency across systems
Partner with Engineering and Digital Operations teams to improve scalability of engineering processes as product complexity and organizational size increase
Contribute to future-state initiatives involving model-based engineering, digital thread visibility, workflow automation, and engineering process modernization
NX & CAD User Support
Support Siemens NX managed-mode environments, integrations, templates, configurations, and engineering workflows
Troubleshoot NX-related operational issues involving Teamcenter integration, datasets, assemblies, drawings, and environment behavior
Support rollout, adoption, and operationalization of new engineering tools, workflows, templates, and capabilities
Assist engineering users with day-to-day CAD/PLM operational support needs
Help improve engineering productivity by reducing workflow friction and improving system usability
Support evolving engineering initiatives involving PMI, MBD, CAD automation, and digital engineering workflows
Training, Documentation & User Enablement
Create and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, support guides, release documentation, and workflow standards
Conduct focused training sessions for engineering and operational teams
Support onboarding activities for new Teamcenter and NX users
Help users adopt standardized engineering workflows, release processes, and data management practices
Communicate operational changes and system updates clearly to impacted teams
Identify recurring training gaps and proactively improve user enablement strategies
Build and maintain a scalable internal knowledge base supporting long term operational growth
Cross-System Awareness & Digital Thread support
Develop understanding of how Teamcenter interacts with ERP, MES, manufacturing, and enterprise reporting systems
Support integration testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities involving Teamcenter and downstream systems
Identify cross-system mismatches and escalate issues with clear operational and technical context
Support digital thread initiatives connecting Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations
Participate in future integration and process improvement initiatives involving Teamcenter, NetSuite, Manufacturo, and enterprise reporting platforms
Help improve end-to-end engineering and manufacturing data consistency across enterprise systems
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered
5+ years of experience supporting Siemens Teamcenter in an engineering or manufacturing environment
Strong understanding of Teamcenter administration, workflows, engineering data structures, release processes, and configuration management concepts
Experience troubleshooting operational Teamcenter issues involving workflows, datasets, BOMs, ownership, access, integrations, and engineering data management
Familiarity with Siemens NX managed-mode environments and CAD/PLM integrations
Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams
Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, rapidly evolving engineering environments
Strong attention to detail and commitment to engineering data integrity and process consistency
Interest in continuously improving engineering systems, workflows, and operational scalability
Experience supporting Teamcenter integrations with ERP, MES, or enterprise reporting platforms
Familiarity with Teamcenter Dispatcher, workflows, engineering release automation, and engineering change processes
Exposure to Teamcenter ITK, APIs, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or customization frameworks
Aerospace, defense, or complex hardware manufacturing experience
Familiarity with SQL, reporting tools, enterprise data environments, or digital thread initiatives
Experience supporting enterprise digital transformation or engineering systems modernization initiatives
Exposure to PMI, MBD, CAD automation, or model-based engineering initiatives
Motivated by solving operational challenges with scalable technology solutions

usv-simscale:greenhouse:8564174002.title: Principal Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Architect
usv-simscale:greenhouse:8564174002.description:
The Role: The Bridge Between Rigor and Velocity

We are looking for a Principal GRC Architect who can solve a unique challenge: How do we maintain "gold-standard" security certifications without killing our "ship-fast" culture?

We are already under continuous observation for SOC 2 Type II and are GDPR compliant. We are now ready to evolve toward the most rigorous standards in the industry: TISAX, ITAR, and FedRAMP. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will be the architect of the system and the person turning the gears, designing the roadmap and then personally implementing the controls.

Your mission is to reconcile the rigidity of international standards with the agility of a fast-paced software company. You aren't here to create bureaucracy; you’re here to engineer compliance directly into our AWS infrastructure.

Core Responsibilities

  • Maintain Continuous Observation: Uphold our SOC 2 Type II standard using automated monitoring to ensure compliance is a constant state, not an annual event.
  • Technical Infrastructure Strategy: Directly satisfy the high-bar technical requirements of ITAR and FedRAMP. This includes managing the transition to/oversight of AWS GovCloud, defining network security boundaries, and ensuring encryption and IAM standards meet federal requirements.
  • Bridge the "Speed vs. Standard" Gap: Act as a technical enabler for the Engineering team, designing and implementing controls (e.g., change management, access reviews) that satisfy auditors but don’t bottleneck our Engineering or DevOps teams.
  • Lead Global Expansion: Architect and execute the technical and procedural implementation of TISAX, ITAR, and FedRAMP.
  • GDPR Stewardship: Act as the internal authority on privacy, ensuring our data mapping and PIAs remain current without adding unnecessary friction.
  • Customer Trust & Sales Support: Join calls with customer Infosec counterparts and handle technical vendor questionnaires to prove our security posture can be trusted by the world’s most demanding organizations.
  • Individual Contributor Ownership: Act as a "department of one". You will write the policies, perform the risk assessments, and manage the audits yourself.

What You Bring

  • Technical AWS Depth: You understand how to configure AWS beyond simple evidence collection. You are familiar with GovCloud, VPC isolation, network security, and IAM architecture.
  • Standard Mastery: Expert-level knowledge in at least two of: TISAX, ITAR, or FedRAMP. You have previously led a company through these audits or were responsible for maintaining their compliance.
  • Privacy & AI Knowledge: A deep, working knowledge of GDPR and an active interest in the evolving landscape of AI regulation.
  • The "Translator" Skillset: You can translate rigid regulatory requirements into actionable technical tasks that make sense to a developer.
  • Independence: You are energized by "getting your hands dirty" and owning the full lifecycle of a program without a team to delegate to.
  • Communication: Exceptional English skills; able to negotiate effectively with both internal engineers and external auditors.

What you can expect from us

  • A direct seat at the table: full ownership of the compliance and GRC roadmap.
  • Your work directly enables our largest enterprise and government deals: measurable, visible business impact.
  • Enjoy flexible hours and the freedom to work remotely from anywhere in the world.
  • Access comprehensive health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and wellness support.
  • Stay active with subsidized gym memberships, sports meetups, and wellness programs.
  • Grow as a professional with online/offline learning, language courses, and tech talks.
  • Connect at team events, join support groups, and contribute to our ESG and DE&I initiatives.
  • Participate in fun team challenges and competitions for added excitement and team spirit.
  • Multicultural team (35+ nationalities), flexible work, relocation and visa support where applicable.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SimScale

At SimScale, we look beyond borders and hire great talent from all parts of the world. With our team consisting of people from various backgrounds, we truly embrace diversity and encourage everyone to be themselves. We are unified by curiosity, dedication and our team spirit! As an equal opportunity employer, we acknowledge that our employees have different aspirations and career goals, and therefore are committed to create a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. A copy of SimScale's full recruiting guideline can be made available on request. Kindly let us know how you would like to be addressed and whether you have specific requirements for the interview.

verdane-evondos-group:teamtailor:5eec5f6.title: Mulesoft Developer
verdane-evondos-group:teamtailor:5eec5f6.description:
We are looking for a smart and motivated MuleSoft Developer with at least 3 years of hands-on experience in MuleSoft development. Our ideal colleague would be able to design, build, test, and support integration solutions using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. The person should be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, able to handle pressure, and willing to learn and improve continuously. 
About Evondos Group    
Evondos Group is the European market leader in medication management, with over 500 employees working in the Nordics, UK and the Netherlands. Evondos' services enables tens of thousands of people who require medication to receive support in proper medication use through our automatic medication dispensers. This improves and enhances patient safety and medication adherence. Evondos helps clients live independently in their own homes, reducing the pressure on home care services, allowing them to focus on more complex care needs.  
This is the role - What you will do: 
You will be responsible for Developing and Supporting Integration solutions between different systems [ERP, CRM], could platforms and services. You will work closely with architects, business teams, developers, and testers to understand requirements and deliver reliable APIs and integrations. 
Your main responsibilities will include: 
Design and develop APIs and integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform 
Build Mule applications using Anypoint Studio 
Work with REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, and common integration patterns 
Create and maintain API specifications using RAML or OpenAPI 
Implement error handling, logging, monitoring, and security best practices 
Connect MuleSoft with different systems such as cloud platforms, Salesforce, ERP, and other enterprise applications 
Support testing, deployment, and production issue resolution 
Work with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes when needed 
Follow coding standards, documentation standards, and project guidelines 
Collaborate with team members and communicate clearly about progress, risks, and blockers 
This could be you 
You have at least 3 years of experience in MuleSoft development 
Strong experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform 
Good knowledge of API-led connectivity 
Experience with REST APIs and web services 
Experience with DataWeave transformations 
Good understanding of integration design and system-to-system communication 
Experience with error handling, logging, and debugging in MuleSoft 
Basic knowledge of security concepts such as OAuth, certificates, and API policies 
Experience with Git or similar version control tools 
Good problem-solving skills 
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines 
Good communication skills and a positive attitude 
What we offer 
A company culture where the customer is always at the center, work is practical and down-to-earth, and development is everyone’s responsibility
A flexible hybrid role that allows you to shape your work week combined with meaningful in‑person collaboration at our office in Zoetermeer
The space to take initiative and bring ideas to the table
At Evondos we are passionate about developing a desired workplace where people can grow with the company and do their work with pride and joy, encouraged by our meaningful mission of enabling an independent life at home
Apply now! 
Do you recognize yourself in this profile? Apply now and join our passionate team at Evondos!
💜 Together we are strong!  💜  
* As a fair employer, we are committed to selecting the best candidates for the role. Please note that only applicants who are eligible to work in the country of work location and hold valid EU work authorization will be considered for this position. 
** Recruitment Agencies: We are confident in finding the right candidate through our own network. Should we need recruitment assistance, we will work with the agencies we already do collaborate with.

xange-360learning:lever:8fb42b62-207d-45.title: Technical Services Developer
xange-360learning:lever:8fb42b62-207d-45.description:
The Technical Services team is a fast-growing team at 360Learning, offering customized technical solutions for our clients, particularly in the Enterprise segment. These solutions include front-end developments, connectors & integrations,  automations, reporting, and other innovative developments. 
We are now looking for a Technical Services Developer , who will join our well established team of 6 developers to deliver value to our customers, by developing new solutions and maintaining existing ones, bridging the gap between complex business requirements and technical excellence. In this role, you’ll spend your time crafting high-quality front-end plugins for the 360Learning platform, integrations and customizations, while also stepping into the spotlight as a TS Hero on a rotating basis to support and enhance our live solutions. 
As a Technical Services Developer , you will report to the Dev Lead and the Head of Tech Services. Your mission is to transform specifications into robust software while maintaining a high standard of code quality through collaboration and rigorous testing. 
Build & Innovate: Design, develop, and maintain scalable technical solutions across our ecosystem, including integrations and automations built on Workato, internal tools, reporting solutions, web applications, plugins, and enhancements to our BigCommerce integration. 
Ensure Quality: Perform tests (providing proof of results) and participate in peer code reviews to keep our codebase "hero-grade." 
Document: Write clear Setup Guides and Deployment Methodologies to empower our Implementation Specialists and clients. 
Collaborate: Participate in daily stand-ups and provide workload estimates to help our Tech Consultants manage client expectations. 
Discover the 360Learning platform  
Have a global view on our code-base 
Obtain an understanding of customer needs & the custom technical solutions to build 
Get to know the team 
Develop a first internal project 
Gain skills on our tool stack (Workato, snowflake, github, ….) 
Develop Technical Solutions for our customers 
Take support shifts 
Contribute to the development of a wide variety of technical solutions 
Ensure scalability of all solutions through documentation, and enablement of teams 
Test solutions developed other team members 
Proactively propose new solutions to develop 
Upskill on new technologies & tools 
Review the code of your peers 
Participate in enhancing our processes towards excellence 
4+ years of experience in software engineering, front-end development, and back-end development/integrations 
Experience working with node.js and vue.js 
Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, authentication methods, and asynchronous workflows  
Ability to design scalable, efficient, and maintainable technical solutions 
Experience working with SQL databases or DataWarehouses (Snowflake is a plus) 
Exposure to cloud platforms is appreciated 
Interest in full stack development, Git workflows and CI/CD practices 
You have excellent analytical skills, structured thinking and the ability to synthesise  
Strong troubleshooting and debugging mindset 
Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities 
Fluent English (US/UK), French speaking is a plus 
Knowledge of BigCommerce is a plus. 
Enthusiasm for our culture explained https://bit.ly/Convexity360L 
Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈 
Benefits/Perks : Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.  
Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠 
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion : We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝 
Corporate Social Responsibility : Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍 
Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆 
Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager 
Technical Test to do at home 
Discovery Meeting with our Technical Services Dev Lead 
Clarification meeting with our Head of Technical Services 
Culture-fit interview with our VP Professional Services 
Ref Check 
Offer! 
Who We Are 
360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place. 
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.
Learning Includes Everyone. 
In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

yc-zip:ashbyhq:2113e35a-8938-44b8-901f-1.title: Commercial Account Executive
yc-zip:ashbyhq:2113e35a-8938-44b8-901f-1.description:
ABOUT ZIP



Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

 - You’re a closer, trusted advisor, product consultant – you’re working with prospects day-in-day-out to deliver immense ROI in an efficient, value-based sales cycle

 - You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

 - You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

 - You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org




YOU WILL

 - Become a procurement expert – gaining deep knowledge of the procurement challenges specific to the industry, from clinical trials to research funding allocation.

 - Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

 - Become a procurement expert – learning the ins and outs of the procurement market, which is deeply ready for change and new solutions

 - Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

 - Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of closing experience in technology SaaS sales

 - Bachelor’s degree (specifically in Finance, Technology, or a related field or experiential equivalent)

 - Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

 - You’d describe yourself as organized, efficient with your time, and excellent communicator

 - Experience using tools like Salesforce, Zoominfo, LinkedIn SalesNav, and Outreach

 - Willing to go the extra mile to make sure our customers, company, team, and yourself succeed




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience selling to procurement, finance, IT, legal



The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $180,000 OTE. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.




PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage

 - 🍽️ Catered lunches & dinners for SF employees

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget



We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!
